evidence.quote: All of the fracture surfaces are characterized by the dimples which is an indicator of ductile fracture. With the increase of Nb content, the dimples become smaller due to the increase of b-Nb particles.

The solution strengthening of Nb dissolved into the matrix may enhance the mechanical properties

the addition of Nb may refine the grain size of matrix. This suggestion is supported by the reported results in which the solution-treated Ti44Ni47Nb9 alloy shows an average grain size of about 3 mm which is much smaller than the typical value of TiNi alloy
the load of matrix may be transferred to the Nb, resulting in the increased critical stress to induce martensitic transformation, similar to the case of nanostructured Nb reinforced TiNi
This can be mainly contributed to the stress-induced B2 /B19 transformation and plastic deformation of b-Nb phase
